method: restricted wild cluster bootstrap-t, Webb weights, two-sided, Holm within the family; estimand: per-question four-reader mean, clustered by conversation

scenarios.name: optimistic
scenarios.source: tau: public BEAM-10M per-conversation SD 0.0732 minus the question-sampling part at 20 questions (dev within-conversation variance); arms agree on 50% of questions; readers keep the arm's score 50% of the time

scenarios.name: central
scenarios.source: tau: BEAM-1M dev between-conversation spread beyond question sampling, all of it treated as specific to one system; arms agree on 35%; readers keep the arm's score 70% of the time

scenarios.name: pessimistic
scenarios.source: tau: the whole public BEAM-10M per-conversation SD 0.0732 treated as system-specific; arms agree on 20%; readers keep the arm's score 90% of the time

designs.label: 10 conversations of 10 to 30 questions (200 total), Holm over 9
9 of 10 conversations retained and 5% of the rest missing per comparison, Holm over 9
10 conversations x 20 questions, Holm over 4 (the shrink rule)

decision.rule: If the central scenario's single-effect minimum detectable difference on the balanced design exceeds 10 points for most of the 9 rows, Family 1 shrinks to gbrain-defaults against the 4 strongest dev rows; if the shrunk family's still exceeds 10 points, S1 is published descriptively with its detectable difference and no superiority claim.
decision.note: Comparator rows are exchangeable under these inputs, so one detectable difference applies to every row; rerun when dev smokes give paired cross-system rows.
